title: BetaEdit
body:
# BetaEdit

BetaEdit is a world editing mod for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3.

Inspired by classic world editing tools, it adds a set of commands for quickly modifying large areas of your world without leaving the game. Whether you're building a map, clearing terrain, or making large-scale changes, BetaEdit helps reduce repetitive work while staying true to the Beta experience.

## Features

* Wooden axe selection wand
* Region selection using `//pos1` and `//pos2`
* Set entire regions to a specific block
* Replace blocks within a selection
* Fill areas between coordinates
* Clear selected regions
* Undo and redo recent edits
* Multiplayer support
* Block metadata support
